w1_picks.validation_summary: Backtested 28 months. Full window: +107.8% CAGR, Sharpe 1.64, -24.9% MaxDD vs market +40.8% / 0.65 / -23.5%. Holdout 10mo OOS: +131% CAGR, Sharpe 2.78, -8.9% MaxDD vs market +50% / 1.32 / -5.6%.
w1_picks.disclaimer: Algorithmic ranking for the next ~5 trading days. Not investment advice. The model has positive expected alpha vs a passive EGX weekly buy-hold; individual weeks can still lose. Verify against the EGX official tape before acting.
